integrity: The theorem is supported by a complete algebraic proof, plus symbolic exact-identity checks; existing equiangular projector examples in Yun et al. (2021) are explicitly credited, and the separate stochastic error comparison is distinguished from the matrix-product mean norm comparison.
scientific_limitations: Only the three-unit-row planar equiangular tight frame, uniform sampling, isotropic initial covariance, and expected squared Euclidean error at epoch endpoints. The sharp comparison concerns asymptotic exponential rates, not all finite iterates or larger frames; no independent audit has been performed.
title: The \(3-\sqrt{3}\) relaxation frontier for shuffle-once and IID equiangular Kaczmarz
